name: craft-suite
description: Meta-bundle: the creative-build studio in one install — concept-first creative direction with a tiered motion catalog and WebGL/Three.js effects (craft-layer), plus ui-ux: per-library stack skills (shadcn, ReUI, Aceternity, Astryx, MUI, Tailwind), the WCAG audit, CSS-variable theming with a live colour preview, and the real-component preview that renders 2-3 variants with the project's OWN components on its dev server. design-studio was retired 2026-09-14; live registry lookups route to shadcn's official MCP and ReUI's hosted server, named in ui-ux's stack skills. Uninstall with /craft-suite:uninstall.
